scenario_text: Epidemiologists estimate the basic reproduction potential of pathogens across settings as a function of average contact rate and infectious period. They compile cross-sectional estimates from many independent populations to relate these drivers to the resulting reproduction quantity. The relationship is an instantaneous algebraic combination of transmissibility drivers. Population structure is held fixed as background.
